services.name: Maui Snorkeling
services.desc: Molokini Crater is one out of three volcanic islets of its type in the world. Located off the coast of South Maui, here is one of the most incredible snorkel sites in all of Hawaii. Characterized by its crescent shape, Molokini is a Federally protected marine and seabird sanctuary. Only reached by boat, Molokini Crater is a top Maui snorkel site. Also popular for scuba diving, visitors can travel underway to a rare islet that’s abundant with history, vibrant coral species, and Maui marine life.
